title: Underlying abelian etale sheaf of a module sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, let $\Lambda:\mathrm{Type}(u+1)$ be a commutative ring, and use the small etale site of $X:\mathrm{Scheme}_u$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For the categories of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], define $U_X:\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)\to\mathrm{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{et}})$ by composition with the forgetful functor $\Lambda\text{-}\mathrm{Mod}\to\mathrm{Ab}$. On each etale object $W\to X$, it sends a sheaf $F$ to the underlying abelian group of $F(W)$ and sends a sheaf morphism to the underlying additive map of its component at $W$; its restriction maps are the underlying additive restriction maps of $F$.
